intended_object: For a ChartLocalBall b at x (an open neighbourhood with a C^n diffeomorphism, restricting the chart φ = chartAt E x, onto a model ball), the open ball B(φ(x), r) ⊆ E of radius r = b.radius, as an open set. This is the target of the coordinate diffeomorphism (from the docstring and the structure's coord field).
explanation: The body is `chartBall x b.radius`, which unfolds to `⟨Metric.ball ((chartAt E x) x) b.radius, Metric.isOpen_ball⟩`. That is the open ball of radius r around φ(x), with its openness proof. It is literally the codomain of `b.coord`, as the docstring says. The radius is positive, so the ball is nonempty and contains its centre. The definition uses only the metric on the normed model space E and the chart at x, so nothing is overly specialised. It is a simple, correct abbreviation.
